title: Add destination_v13: walks in every direction and a ghost pay of 0.8 at 5 mm
summary: destination_v13 is destination_v12 where every fresh command is a walk in a uniform direction (no zero commands, turns or arcs; a fifth still stop after 4 s to 12 s) and the rational destination pay keeps its shape but is four times wider, 0.8 at 5 mm instead of at 1.2 mm. On the surrogate, v10 to v12 never held the 0.8 window at 0.125 m/s, where walks stayed about 1.6 to 1.8 mm from the ghost on average.
next: Train destination_v13 from the v9 checkpoint on the surrogate and test it against v9 at 0.05 to 0.15 m/s.
reason: A named experiment that no gate or registry entry uses yet; the canonical task and reward are unchanged.
